instruction: I got some Splitwise group invitations over phone voice messages the day before yesterday. If their number is in my phone contact book, accept it, otherwise delete those messages.
notes: Scenario fixed to two relevant Splitwise-invitation voice messages received on 2023-05-16 (day before yesterday): one from a number present in the contact book (accept its invitation code on Splitwise) and one from an unknown number (delete the voice message). Date filtering on created_at is done client-side after phone.search_voice_messages (query 'splitwise'). (in-contacts ?n) is a static world truth; the agent only learns it via phone.search_contacts (query = sender number), modeled by (contact-checked ?n), which gates both accept and delete. Accept requires in-contacts, delete requires not in-contacts, so the planner can never join the wrong group or delete the wrong message; this matches the evaluation which demands exactly the accepted groups' memberships added and exactly the non-contact messages removed. supervisor-complete-task takes the joined group and deleted message as record parameters so its precondition is the goal conjunction, and it is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on all other actions. No answer is needed.
